children: ICICI Securities's research report on Chalet Hotels

Chalet Hotels (CHALET)’s Q2FY27 hospitality revenue/EBITDA grew 8%/11% YoY as RevPAR was up 7% YoY owing to a temporary construction disruption at the Powai, Mumbai hotel. As per the company, it expects a demand bounce back in H2FY27 with a pick-up in weddings/MICE and recovery in Westin Powai’s occupancy. Further, the opening of Delhi Airport hotel and Cignus Powai office tower in H1FY28, would be additional earnings driver. With CHALET’s operational hotels’ portfolio poised to grow by 1,655 keys to over 5,400 keys by Mar’30E, alongside its leasing traction, we estimate 15%/20% revenue/EBITDA CAGRs over FY26–29 (ex-residential). Retain BUY with an unchanged SoTPbased TP of INR 1,095, basis 22x Mar’28E hotel EV/EBITDA. Key risks: Slowdown in hotel demand and office leasing.
We retain BUY with an unchanged SoTP-based TP of INR 1,095, based on 22x Mar’28E hotel EV/EBITDA, 8% cap rate for rental assets, and residual value of Vivarea, Bengaluru residential project.
